items.markdown:
Traveling from Chumphon to Koh Tao takes `about 1 hour and 45 minutes via high-speed catamaran` , with options like Lomprayah High Speed Ferries, Songserm, and Boonsiri. Prices average around £40 to £51 ($40–$51 USD) depending on the operator and season.[](https://www.directferries.co.uk/chumphon_lomprayah_pier_koh_tao_mae_haad_pier_ferry.htm) [[1]](https://www.directferries.co.uk/chumphon_lomprayah_pier_koh_tao_mae_haad_pier_ferry.htm)[[2]](https://www.insidesamui.com/getting-here/chumphon-to-koh-tao/)[[3]](https://www.rome2rio.com/s/Chumphon/Koh-Tao-Thailand)[[4]](https://www.directferries.com/koh_tao_mae_haad_pier_chumphon_lomprayah_pier_ferry.htm)

Ferry Options and Schedules

- **Lomprayah Catamaran** : Departs from [Chumphon Lomprayah Pier](https://www.directferries.com/chumphon_lomprayah_pier_koh_tao_mae_haad_pier_ferry.htm) (Thung Makham Noi) around 07:00, 13:15, and sometimes early morning. Takes 1 hour 45 minutes. This is the fastest and most popular choice.[](https://openferry.com/routes/chumphon-lomprayah-pier-koh-tao-mae-haad-pier) [[1]](https://openferry.com/routes/chumphon-lomprayah-pier-koh-tao-mae-haad-pier)[[2]](https://www.baolau.com/en/s/chumphon/koh-tao/)[[3]](https://www.directferries.com/chumphon_lomprayah_pier_koh_tao_mae_haad_pier_ferry.htm)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=USlZOWXOms0&t=65)
- **Songserm / Boonsiri** : Offer alternative daytime joint bus and ferry transfers from Chumphon town or the railway station, taking roughly 2 to 2.5 hours.[](https://www.rome2rio.com/s/Chumphon/Koh-Tao-Thailand) 
- **Night Boat** : Departs around 21:00 or 23:00 and takes 6 to 8 hours, utilizing floor mattresses for a slower, budget-friendly overnight trip.[](https://thailandtravelroutes.com/ferry-times-from-chumphon-to-koh-tao/) [[1]](https://thailandtravelroutes.com/ferry-times-from-chumphon-to-koh-tao/)

Arrival and Transfer Tips

- **Destination** : All passenger ferries arrive at Mae Haad Pier on the west coast of Koh Tao.[](https://www.directferries.com/chumphon_lomprayah_pier_koh_tao_mae_haad_pier_ferry.htm) [[1]](https://ferryadvice.com/en/reviews/ferry-schedule-from-chumphon-to-koh-tao)
- **Getting to Your Hotel** : Some resorts provide a free pickup service at Mae Haad Pier. Otherwise, local shared truck taxis (songthaews) cost about 150 baht per person to reach other parts of the island.[](https://ferryadvice.com/en/reviews/ferry-schedule-from-chumphon-to-koh-tao) 
- **Booking** : Tickets can be secured ahead of time through booking platforms or directly at the mainland piers, though advance booking is recommended during peak travel months.[](https://www.directferries.com/koh_tao_mae_haad_pier_chumphon_lomprayah_pier_ferry.htm)
